description: Reusable failure classes for Console process intelligence. Process edits add controls here + in workflows/tools — never one-shot PR-named hooks.

classes.symptom: C or T not signed by pinned SSH authority
classes.control: Resign C/T; handoff checklist; never force-push unsigned tip

classes.symptom: documentation-manifest blob_sha does not match tip ledger blob
classes.control: Prebind tip blob on C; T only adds Authority tip section

classes.symptom: verify.mjs / preflight digests missing new CI jobs
classes.control: Update digests/verify when editing ci.yml job graph

classes.symptom: New //tools/buck product wrappers in ci.yml without map row
classes.control: Map or document unmapped; ceiling only shrinks

classes.symptom: Autonomous turn only restates unchanged CI WAIT
classes.control: Dual track: fleet action + product/process action every wake

classes.symptom: Push while Required CI in_progress cancels running cone
classes.detector: gh run list status in_progress on same branch
classes.control: Batch local fixes → one push → wait complete

classes.symptom: Open PR mergeStateStatus BEHIND after main advances
classes.control: open-pr-fleet tip-sync report; restack in PR worktree

classes.symptom: Push/PR without local gates that would have caught hosted red
classes.detector: compare hosted fail step to admit_commands for class
classes.control: domain-increment Admit phase; optional PreToolUse on push

classes.symptom: Soft red or non-hard block observed but not on lane board / left unowned
classes.detector: work-manager silence_check; program-control productivity audit; lane-board.live.json vs open PR scan
classes.control: work-manager must upsert every soft_red_sources/hard_block_sources hit; pr-babysit requeues residuals

classes.symptom: Multiple open tip-writing PRs (manifest/baseline/tip/ci.yml) thrashing serial queue
classes.detector: tools/ci/assess-tip-contention.mjs or work-manager tip writer inventory
classes.control: Serialize tip queue; batch pure-domain tests; no new tip PR while tip_writers>=2

classes.symptom: PR review not approve and no fix loop / board review_fix item
classes.control: Fix until approve or max rounds then board blocked with evidence; merge only on approve

classes.symptom: Several small PRs each pay full Required CI wall (~25-45m)
classes.detector: count open PRs with full CI vs total LOC changed
classes.control: Stack or batch when work is pure unit tests and would tip-serialize anyway

classes.symptom: CLAUDE.md or README.md lens projection drifted from the AGENTS.md canonical list
classes.control: Regenerate the numbered projections from AGENTS.md; never hand-edit one projection alone
